<a id="frame_parts_top_left"></a>
### [`frame_parts_top_left`](../../../../src/shapes/frame_part_tables.asm#L6) `$7AE0-$7B27`

*data*

Frames $00-$3a are the fighter, frames $3b-$42 the bonus bull, with shape_page_offset $40. No script uses frames $43-$47.

- **Read by:** [`shape_build`](shape_build_3165.md#shape_build), [`$34B6`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L107)

<a id="ram_noise_after_frames"></a>
### [`ram_noise_after_frames`](../../../../src/shapes/frame_part_tables.asm#L105) `$7D68-$7DFF`

*data*

Unused: no code reads these 152 bytes as data. They hold the uninitialised RAM pattern of $3768-$37ff. The reads come from the 1-player run after rank overflow, with garbage frame numbers.
